name: week
title: Programming office: weekly review
subtitle: Private snapshot. All call times are UTC.

sections.title: Season decisions
sections.sql: select p.code,p.name,p.owner,p.status,(select count(*)::int from sessions s where s.production_id=p.id and s.status<>'cancelled') calls,(select count(*)::int from programme_items i where i.production_id=p.id) works,(select count(*)::int from rights_gaps g where g.production=p.code) rights_gaps,(select count(*)::int from actions a where a.production_id=p.id and a.status='open') open_actions from productions p where p.status<>'closed' order by p.review_due,p.code

sections.title: Schedule clashes
sections.sql: select first_call,second_call,space,first_start,second_start,issue from schedule_clashes order by first_start,first_call

sections.title: Rights follow-up
sections.sql: select code,production,title,performance,starts_at,issue from rights_gaps order by starts_at,code

sections.title: Actions due
sections.sql: select code,production,description,owner,due,overdue from action_register where status='open' order by due,code

name: rehearsal-board
title: Rehearsal and performance calls
subtitle: Private snapshot. All call times are UTC.

sections.title: Calls
sections.sql: select code,production,kind,space,starts_at,ends_at,planned_people,status from call_sheet where status<>'cancelled' order by starts_at,code

sections.title: Safety evidence missing
sections.sql: select code,production,space,kind,starts_at,revision from call_sheet where status<>'cancelled' and not safety_reviewed order by starts_at,code

sections.title: Capacity exceptions
sections.sql: select code,production,space,planned_people,capacity from call_sheet where status<>'cancelled' and planned_people>capacity order by starts_at,code
